summary: CRH America Finance filed a preliminary 424B5 for a multi-tranche, fully guaranteed debt offering by CRH plc: fixed-rate notes due 2029, 2032, 2034, 2037 and 2057 plus floating-rate notes due 2029 (SOFR plus spread), all senior unsecured and pari passu with existing unsubordinated debt, with change-of-control repurchase and tax-redemption provisions. Amounts, coupons and maturities are blank. Substantially concurrently, CRH launched cash tender offers for Arcosa's $400M 4.375% 2029s and $600M 6.875% 2032s plus exchange offers into up to $1B of new guaranteed notes. Watch pricing, tender take-up and exchange participation.
